# Live Popivka schedule regression

This is external black-box acceptance of a schedule reader fix, starting from the released88 runtime. It does not assign an address queue or measure coverage. The existing public native89 Popivka fixture represents an already-saved correct queue; it is seeded only into a disposable test emulator. No schedule or interval is seeded. The original address ID, address, manual correction, queue and reminders must survive88→89.

`source.py` independently observes the real current Cherkasy operator homepage and daily publications. Its standard-library HTMLParser retains adjacent inline text without adding spaces, validates all12 queues, explicit interval syntax, dates and partial-update context, archives exact rawHTML/SHA, and computes expected intervals. It imports no app code. A malformed interval, missing full publication or unavailable source fails the test.

The existing registered `verify-capital-candidate-89.yml` adds3 live jobs on this hotfix branch for APIs30/35/36 with read-only repository permissions. It verifies baseline/candidate bytes, certificate and installed hashes; records the baseline live outcome; upgrades the same installation; waits for a fresh official schedule matching the independently observed intervals; captures the actual graph and exact address/source card; then blocks the app UID on both IPv4 and IPv6 and verifies the same cache/source timestamp after restart. All read-only SQLite captures retain their originals and sidecars. Only explicitly transient hot-journal/malformed capture errors permit up to3 fresh pulls; no immutable flag, DB repair or journal removal is used.

The baseline failure is evidence, not a mandatory assertion: if the publisher has repaired its markup by the time the test runs, the oldAPK may also read successfully. Candidate success still requires exact official intervals and actual native screenshots. An independently changed publication or a source/network failure remains a failed/unresolved attempt, not an accepted queue or source success.

Candidate metadata is `.github/qa/native89/meta.json`; an explicit `apkUrl` must point to its exact pinned filename in this public repository's candidate directory. The historical feature candidate is not substituted for the urgent hotfix. No workflow edits latest.json or publishes a release. The same dispatch also runs the existing6 upgrade/offline/theme/UI retention combinations against the same hotfix metadata; the live test does not replace those checks.

Offline timestamps are anchored after UID isolation and force-stop, immediately before restart. A legitimate online auto-refresh during screenshots can replace the first observed checkedAt; comparing against that older observation would falsely reject a preserved cache. The frozen pre-restart capture must still match the exact independent official intervals, and the offline capture must retain its exact source timestamp. Original failed attempts remain separate. `suite:live` repeats only the three live jobs on the unchanged APK.
